_note: Hit-stop by weight, with a freeze budget (Game Design's rulings-2026-10-19b.md 4a and 4b, fight-feel.md section 6; sim/core/hitstop.gd; docs/architecture/feel-core.md).
_enabled: the one switch. SimCore.newMatch copies it into S.hitstopOn unless the match's setup has its own "hitstop". Off: every hit holds the clock as today, no budget state, and this file is not read into a replay

ticks._note: a hit's stop in ticks by the weight it names (o.weight), Game Design's table of rulings-2026-10-22.md 5b and 6: a mash's later blows flow (light_flow, 0: no stop; Encounter names them, each within 12 ticks of the last), its first blow stops (light_mash, a mashed or burst light, 2), a tapped light 3, a medium 5, a heavy 8, a launch or a close 12, a full launch 14; decisive (a finisher's last, a duel of perfects' send, a blow that breaks a region: the core's) 20; ko the KO, 24 at most. A stop of n ticks freezes n

_cut: Game Design's second step (rulings-2026-10-22.md 5b): over the budget, every stop under a decisive blow is x cutMul, rounded, at least cutFloor, until the share falls back under; over budget.deepShare, x cutDeepMul in place of cutMul, against stutter (7d: no ten-second block over 40% frozen). Decisive blows and the KO are never cut, and a stop of 0 stays 0

budget._note: the frozen time of the last windowS live seconds is at most share of it (18% of 10 s: 108 ticks). Over it, the second step (cutMul) applies; over deepShare of it (40%: 240 ticks), the deep step (cutDeepMul)
